title: Corporate Diwali gifting: compare contents and plan your order
summary: Choose a festive hamper around your recipients, budget and delivery plan, with a clear list of what each box includes.
sections: Start with the recipients
Separate employee and client requirements before choosing a hamper. Check gift policies, dietary needs and whether the gifts will reach one office or individual addresses.
Compare the contents, not only the box

Hamperia’s listed ₹1,499 festive hamper combines almonds, cashews, chocolates, a candle and a message card. The ₹2,499 selection adds a reed diffuser; the ₹3,499 selection also includes decorative Lakshmi and Ganesh idols. Review each product page and confirm quantities, ingredients and presentation before ordering.
Set aside time for personalisation
Prepare your company logo, message and recipient list before requesting a quote. Ask which branding methods are available for your chosen packaging and approve the artwork before production.
Confirm the delivery plan

Share quantity, destination and required arrival date. Ask for the current production and delivery estimate rather than assuming a festive deadline. Confirm the final bulk quotation, shipping and any customisation charges in writing.

title: Employee welcome kit checklist for new joiners
summary: Compare three welcome kits and choose practical items that help a new colleague feel part of the team.
sections: Choose useful first-day essentials

Start with items a colleague can use immediately. A notebook, pen and water bottle make a practical base. Keep onboarding documents easy to update and put confidential company information in your internal systems.
Compare the three Hamperia kits

The Essential kit is listed at ₹999 and contains a bottle, notebook and pen. The Premium kit at ₹1,899 adds an insulated tumbler. The Signature kit at ₹2,999 also includes a T-shirt, keychain and personalised message card. Check the product details for the final contents and available colours.
Prepare names, sizes and artwork
Check spelling on personalised cards. Collect clothing sizes for kits that include a T-shirt, and ask about available branding methods before approving a company logo placement.
Plan for the next group of joiners
Ask whether the same contents can be supplied again for future hiring. Record the agreed items and branding so subsequent kits are consistent, and confirm stock and timing for every order.

title: How to plan a bulk gift order for your team or clients
summary: Prepare quantities, budget, personalisation and delivery details for a clear corporate gifting quotation.
sections: Write a short gifting brief
List the occasion, recipient count, budget per gift and required date. Explain whether you need ready-made hampers, branded merchandise or individual components to assemble yourself.
Choose a manageable number of options

A small set of gift choices makes approval and packing easier. Separate employee and client options only when their needs differ. Confirm dietary restrictions and any organisation gift policies early.
Compare the complete quotation

Check the agreed contents, quantity, packaging, branding and delivery charges. Listed individual product prices do not settle the cost of a customised bulk order. Ask for the complete total and the payment terms before confirming.
Approve and keep a record

Review the final item list, artwork and any agreed sample. Record approved substitutions and delivery arrangements. Share recipient addresses only through the agreed order process and check the shipment against the order when it arrives.
